implementation.trace: createGraphTrace owns graph copies, marks and exact nodeIds/edgeIds result; createStepEmitter owns unchanged BFS events

implementation.player: Stock Player; recorded immutable history or lazy stepSource; terminal finished event; rewindCapacity 32; maxStepsPerFrame 16; shared timing and input limits
implementation.ownership: Validate before replacing session; stream probes and closes one initial source, then creates a fresh lazy source; Restart uses applied inputs; preserve speed on Apply/mode changes; pagehide disposes Player/viewport and persisted pageshow remounts

implementation.inputBoundary: Example remains undirected/unweighted; directed or weighted edges now explicitly rejected; invalid input uses /graph errors
